basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer based in Brooklyn, NY, with a passion for gaming and video editing. I work remotely, which gives me the flexibility to dive into my hobbies, like playing Dark Souls on PS4 and editing gameplay videos using Kdenlive. I'm a lifelong New York Islanders fan and often catch games whenever I can. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy exploring the city during weekends. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 9 PM EST, when I have some downtime from work and personal commitments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise in software development comes from both formal education and years of hands-on experience. I've also dabbled in video editing as a hobby, learning through online tutorials and community forums.
